name: Apollo Command Module rotation hand controller
view: the CM RHC from behind, as the crew member on the couch sees it: the symmetrical handle (usable with either hand) with its push-to-talk button on top, on the gimbal housing at the end of the couch armrest
origin: JoyPro's own vector drawing: the handle and housing reconstructed from the public Apollo Command Module descriptions (NASA Apollo Operations Handbook overview, Apollo Flight Journal) and public museum photos looked at for proportions; not traced from a photo.
